payload.summary: Most server-side Supabase calls have no deadline, so a stalled database request can hang for minutes on the single app replica
payload.detail: The service-role client (src/lib/supabase/admin.ts:16) is created without a global fetch timeout, and only 14 non-test files in src/ apply .abortSignal() to queries (the readiness probe in src/lib/supabase/health.ts does). Everything else relies on undici's default header/body timeouts (about 300 s). That includes the durable rate-limit RPCs every answer passes through (src/lib/api-rate-limit.ts:300, 360, 424). Search is bounded only by the client disconnecting at 45 s; other routes have no bound. Next action: add a default per-request deadline for server Supabase calls (for example a global fetch wrapper with AbortSignal.timeout, overridable for known long operations such as ingestion and exports), classify the expiry as unavailable, and cover it with a unit test. Check the ingestion worker's long jobs are exempt before rollout.
